systemicRootCause: deriveAuthoritySupport mapped AUTHORITY_FOUND + displayed sources to VERIFIED_CONTROLLING with no answer-level gate; retrieval/source presence was treated as answer confidence.

architecture.answerSupportValidator: services/answer-support-validator.js -- deterministic structural gate (empty / headers-only / empty-primary-section / bare-source-listing / refusal / non-substantive) + a controlled post-generation LLM evaluator (constrained JSON rubric, temperature 0, fail-closed). Not a free-form re-answer.
architecture.trustGate: trust-contract.js: VERIFIED_CONTROLLING requires result.answerSupport.verifiedEligible===true when an attestation is present; absent (internal/deterministic callers only) preserves legacy behavior. The live ask path always sets answerSupport and fails closed on validator error/unavailability.
architecture.askHandlerWiring: ask-handler.js runs the validator only for verified-candidate responses (AUTHORITY_FOUND + displayed sources, not source-only fallback / procedural / restricted / boundary) and exposes payload.answerSupport.
architecture.refusalGuard: philippine-tax-boundary-patterns.js: added allow-patterns for core tax concepts appearing without the word 'tax' (capital gains, holding period, Oplan Kandado, etc.).

liveEnvironment: local authenticated server at HEAD 104bcee against real staging Supabase vector store + real OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini); controlled-LOA ask gate enabled; validator model gpt-4o-mini (only model available on the API key); evidence sanitized
legitimateVerifiedNote: Q46 preserved VERIFIED_CONTROLLING; Q14 (20% final tax on interest) and Q28 (20% final tax on royalties) were SAFELY downgraded to RELATED_AUTHORITY_ONLY because the gpt-4o-mini validator hallucinated that 20% 'should be 15%'. This is a precision cost of the only available validator model, not a safety failure (downgrade is a safe under-claim). Offline against the 7 captured PASS answers the validator preserved 3/7. See recommendations.
restrictedNote: RESTRICT-1 (void-LOA outcome prediction) held RESTRICTED + human review. RESTRICT-2 (generic 'predict CTA outcome' with no LOA/audit trigger) returned an analytical ALLOWED response rather than RESTRICTED -- a PRE-EXISTING outcome-prediction coverage gap, not introduced by 10A8; recorded as P2.
miniFactcheckNote: The 20-question mini set (9 prior false-high-confidence + 2 false refusals + clean controls) produced 0 false VERIFIED_CONTROLLING. Correctness of every substantive answer is NOT re-scored here; the full correctness rerun is PHASE-10A9.
p1Note: The systemic false-VERIFIED_CONTROLLING P1 is resolved: 0/9 and 0/20 false-verified live. Full confirmation across all 50 questions is deferred to PHASE-10A9.
p2Findings: Validator precision cost: with gpt-4o-mini (the only available model), some CORRECT recency-sensitive answers are safely downgraded to RELATED_AUTHORITY_ONLY because the validator hallucinates rate errors (e.g. Q14/Q28 20% final tax flagged as '15%'). Safe under-claim; reduces verified availability. Recommend a stronger or retrieval-text-grounded validator.
Outcome-prediction restriction gap: generic CTA/protest prediction prompts without an LOA/audit trigger are not routed to RESTRICTED (pre-existing).
Retrieval coverage gap persists: Q23/Q43 are no longer refused but return NO_VERIFIED_AUTHORITY (thin retrieval), and ~11 PHASE-10A7 questions still under-answer.
p3Findings: Validator adds ~9-18s latency per verified-candidate answer (one gpt-4o-mini call).
decision: PHASE 10A8 TRUST-CALIBRATION REMEDIATION PASS WITH RECOMMENDATIONS
